name: Command Deck

pattern.confidenceChips: always pair an icon with a word — never color alone
pattern.dashboard: slim status strip, four metric tiles (one number, one label, one action), table-grammar panels

rules: Primary red is reserved for the primary call to action, selected-nav indicator, and attention top-rules
Readable contrast first; distinguish states with more than color
Respect Windows high-contrast and accessibility preferences
Design for resizing, display scale, light/dark where the framework supports it, keyboard/mouse/touch
source: Chosen by SEAN 2026-10-20 for InstallScope; house direction for new Windows apps unless a project has its own established design
